theorem: new plants initialize consecutive_unwatered=1 and watered_today=false
if same-day EOD executes, an unwatered new plant increments again and becomes WEED at consecutive_unwatered>=2, so a surviving new plant needs at least PLANT+WATER unit actions
if the episode terminal horizon arrives before same-day EOD, that weed transition cannot execute, so the hard action-budget lower bound is only the PLANT action
the official interpreter's final executable callback is episodeSteps-2; callbacks credited by the envelope are capped by the earlier of same-day EOD and that terminal callback
observation hour is bound to step modulo turnsPerDay before a one-sided ceiling is emitted
BUY_LAND executes in market phase and immediately unlocks the next quadrant for later callbacks, so current empty-owned cells cannot be a hard future cap
total observed board cells is a safe physical overestimate for simultaneous surviving new plants

turnsPerDay, episodeSteps, and maxMarketOrdersPerTurn influence one-sided impossibility ceilings; explicit caller configuration cannot certify IMPOSSIBLE_ACTION_BUDGET without separate configuration custody
